content.value_statement: Incident reviews often miss clear timelines, root causes, and accountable follow-up. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code draft blameless postmortems with structured evidence and practical action items.
actual_capabilities: Drafts standard postmortem documents with executive summaries, impact, timelines, root cause analysis, lessons, and action items.
Provides 5 Whys analysis templates for identifying proximate and contributing causes.
Supplies quick postmortem formats for minor incidents.
Guides postmortem meeting facilitation with agenda timing and discussion prompts.
Organizes follow-up work with priority, owner, due date, and ticket fields.
limitations: Does not collect incident data, metrics, logs, or tickets automatically.
Does not verify facts, customer counts, timelines, or revenue impact without provided evidence.
Does not replace legal, compliance, or security review for regulated incidents.
References an optional implementation playbook that is not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Run a SEV Review
use_cases.description: Turn incident notes into a complete postmortem with impact, timeline, root cause, and action items.

use_cases.title: Convert Notes Into Actions
use_cases.description: Use the structure to identify systemic gaps and assign measurable follow-up work after an outage.

use_cases.title: Standardize Incident Docs
use_cases.description: Create consistent postmortem documents for teams that need repeatable incident review formats.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Postmortem
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for turning notes into a first draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a blameless postmortem from these incident notes. Include executive summary, impact, timeline, root cause, lessons, and action items.

prompt_templates.title: Build a 5 Whys Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for root cause analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 5 Whys analysis for this incident. Separate the proximate cause, contributing factors, evidence, and systemic improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Review Meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-minute postmortem meeting agenda. Include timeline review, analysis prompts, action item planning, and facilitation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for refining a postmortem before publication.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this postmortem draft for blame language, missing evidence, weak action items, and unclear root causes. Suggest concise revisions.

output_examples.input: Incident notes with outage duration, customer impact, alert timing, and rollback details.
output_examples.output: A postmortem draft with executive summary, UTC timeline, impact analysis, root cause, detection gaps, lessons, and assigned action items.

output_examples.input: A short incident summary that says checkout failed after a database change.
output_examples.output: A 5 Whys analysis that links the failure to connection exhaustion, review gaps, missing tests, and documentation needs.

output_examples.input: A completed postmortem draft that may contain blame language and vague follow-up items.
output_examples.output: A revision plan that replaces blame with system-focused wording and turns vague tasks into owner-based actions.

best_practices: Provide timestamps, impact numbers, detection signals, and response decisions before asking for a final draft.
Separate proximate causes from contributing factors and systemic improvements.
Review action items for owner, priority, due date, and measurable completion criteria.
anti_patterns: Using the skill to assign personal blame or write performance feedback.
Submitting vague notes and treating assumptions as facts.
Creating action items without owners, dates, or verification steps.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the timeline, impact, detection signals, response actions, suspected causes, and current follow-up items.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands or collect logs?
faq.answer: No. It provides writing guidance and templates. You must provide any logs, metrics, or ticket details.

faq.question: Can it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it handle security incidents?
faq.answer: It can structure a security postmortem. Use legal, compliance, and security review before sharing sensitive details.

faq.question: How does it keep postmortems blameless?
faq.answer: It redirects analysis from individual fault toward system conditions, detection gaps, and prevention work.

faq.question: Will it verify the root cause?
faq.answer: No. It helps organize evidence and questions, but your team must validate the facts.
